deliverables.name: flanged-bushing

acceptance_criteria.text: Bore is sized for a sliding fit on a 20 mm shaft (ISO clearance/sliding fit class for nominal 20 mm)

check.pass_rule: bore ID matches chosen sliding-fit tolerance band for 20 mm shaft

acceptance_criteria.text: Flange has a 4-hole bolt circle with holes sized for M4 fasteners

check.pass_rule: exactly 4 holes; hole diameter suitable for M4 clearance; holes equally spaced on a common pitch circle on the flange

acceptance_criteria.text: Part is a flanged bushing: cylindrical bushing body plus a distinct flange at one end

check.pass_rule: geometry includes tubular body and flange; bore through body

assumptions.text: Material not specified; default to project/common bushing material (e.g. bronze or 6061) to be chosen by spec_writer

assumptions.basis: only bore nominal and fastener size given

assumptions.text: Sliding fit interpreted as ISO hole-basis sliding/clearance fit for 20 mm (e.g. H7 bore for g6/h6 shaft class) rather than press fit
M4 holes are clearance holes (not tapped) on the flange for through-bolts
assumptions.basis: typical flanged-bushing mounting; user said 'M4 bolt circle' not tapped holes

assumptions.text: Single CAD part only; no drawing, CAM program, or multi-part assembly requested
assumptions.basis: request is 'Design a flanged bushing' with feature constraints only

ambiguities.text: Material for the bushing (bearing bronze vs aluminum vs steel affects fit and use)
Envelope dimensions: flange OD, flange thickness, body OD, body length, overall length, bolt-circle PCD
readings: minimal envelope around 20 mm bore + M4 pattern
